algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 (key = hex-decoded serverSeed); each row draws bit 0|1 at cursor i+1; winningSlot = count of 1-bits; payout = table[winningSlot]

pass1_fresh_seeds.description: Auditor-generated fresh random seeds (crypto.randomBytes) per config. Validates slot distribution against independent binomial(rows, 0.5), serial independence, and simulated RTP at scale. Includes the WTF config (rows 13, risk 4).

pass2_casino_seeds.description: Casino seeds from the captured dataset (revealed serverSeeds). Extends each seed nonce stream and runs two seed-consistency checks: an early-window vs late-window slot chi², and a payout-weighted window-RTP z-test (the economically relevant statistic). SCOPE: this is a SYNTHETIC FIXED-BOARD PROBE — each epoch is evaluated on the single board of its lowest-nonce bet (boardOfEpoch). 22 of the 52 epochs played one board only; the other 30 spread their drops over several boards, so for those it does not replay the actual payout schedule. The 5,000-nonce early window is far longer than the 50, 100, 200 drops observed per seed. CHERRY-PICK SCOPE: every epoch was opened with a client seed generated in the auditor's browser and submitted after the epoch's commitment was published, so seed SUBSTITUTION is blocked on every epoch, conditional on authentic commitment timing (DL-3); the entropy of the seed generator is not demonstrated by the dataset (DL-5).

payoutWeighted.description: Window RTP against its exact per-config mean/SD (from the payout table × independent binomial). zEarly/zLate per seed; a short-window bias would push zEarly negative (fewer tail hits).
